### 16.9 TypeScript Redis Command Executor & Caching Strategy

The TypeScript implementation simulates Redis data structures, commands, TTL, and caching patterns.

```typescript
// ============================================================
// Redis Command Executor — TypeScript
// ============================================================

type RedisValue = string | number | string[];
type ExpireCallback = (key: string) => void;

class RedisStore {
  private data = new Map<string, RedisValue>();
  private lists = new Map<string, string[]>();
  private sets = new Map<string, Set<string>>();
  private hashes = new Map<string, Map<string, string>>();
  private sortedSets = new Map<string, Map<string, number>>(); // member -> score
  private expirations = new Map<string, number>(); // key -> expiry timestamp
  private onExpire: ExpireCallback[] = [];

  onExpiry(cb: ExpireCallback): void { this.onExpire.push(cb); }

  // String operations
  set(key: string, value: string): string {
    this.data.set(key, value);
    return 'OK';
  }

  get(key: string): string | null {
    this.checkExpiry(key);
    return (this.data.get(key) as string) || null;
  }

  incr(key: string): number {
    const val = parseInt(this.get(key) || '0', 10) + 1;
    this.data.set(key, String(val));
    return val;
  }

  // List operations
  lpush(key: string, ...values: string[]): number {
    if (!this.lists.has(key)) this.lists.set(key, []);
    const list = this.lists.get(key)!;
    list.unshift(...values);
    return list.length;
  }

  rpush(key: string, ...values: string[]): number {
    if (!this.lists.has(key)) this.lists.set(key, []);
    const list = this.lists.get(key)!;
    list.push(...values);
    return list.length;
  }

  lpop(key: string): string | null {
    const list = this.lists.get(key);
    if (!list || list.length === 0) return null;
    return list.shift() || null;
  }

  lrange(key: string, start: number, stop: number): string[] {
    const list = this.lists.get(key) || [];
    return list.slice(start, stop >= 0 ? stop + 1 : list.length + stop);
  }

  // Set operations
  sadd(key: string, ...members: string[]): number {
    if (!this.sets.has(key)) this.sets.set(key, new Set());
    const set = this.sets.get(key)!;
    let added = 0;
    for (const m of members) { if (!set.has(m)) { set.add(m); added++; } }
    return added;
  }

  smembers(key: string): string[] {
    return [...(this.sets.get(key) || [])];
  }

  sinter(...keys: string[]): string[] {
    if (keys.length === 0) return [];
    const first = this.sets.get(keys[0]);
    if (!first) return [];
    return [...first].filter(m =>
      keys.slice(1).every(k => this.sets.get(k)?.has(m))
    );
  }

  // Sorted set operations
  zadd(key: string, score: number, member: string): number {
    if (!this.sortedSets.has(key)) this.sortedSets.set(key, new Map());
    const zset = this.sortedSets.get(key)!;
    zset.set(member, score);
    return 1;
  }

  zrange(key: string, start: number, stop: number): string[] {
    const zset = this.sortedSets.get(key);
    if (!zset) return [];
    return [...zset.entries()]
      .sort((a, b) => a[1] - b[1])
      .slice(start, stop >= 0 ? stop + 1 : undefined)
      .map(([member]) => member);
  }

  // Hash operations
  hset(key: string, field: string, value: string): number {
    if (!this.hashes.has(key)) this.hashes.set(key, new Map());
    this.hashes.get(key)!.set(field, value);
    return 1;
  }

  hget(key: string, field: string): string | undefined {
    return this.hashes.get(key)?.get(field);
  }

  hgetall(key: string): Record<string, string> | null {
    const hash = this.hashes.get(key);
    if (!hash) return null;
    const result: Record<string, string> = {};
    for (const [k, v] of hash) result[k] = v;
    return result;
  }

  // TTL
  expire(key: string, seconds: number): number {
    this.expirations.set(key, Date.now() + seconds * 1000);
    return 1;
  }

  ttl(key: string): number {
    const expiry = this.expirations.get(key);
    if (!expiry) return -1;
    const remaining = Math.floor((expiry - Date.now()) / 1000);
    return remaining >= 0 ? remaining : -2;
  }

  private checkExpiry(key: string): void {
    const expiry = this.expirations.get(key);
    if (expiry && Date.now() >= expiry) {
      this.data.delete(key);
      this.lists.delete(key);
      this.sets.delete(key);
      this.hashes.delete(key);
      this.expirations.delete(key);
      for (const cb of this.onExpire) cb(key);
    }
  }

  flushAll(): void {
    this.data.clear();
    this.lists.clear();
    this.sets.clear();
    this.hashes.clear();
    this.sortedSets.clear();
    this.expirations.clear();
  }
}

// Cache-Aside Pattern Demo
class CacheAside {
  constructor(private store: RedisStore, private db: Map<string, string>) {}

  get(key: string): string | null {
    // Try cache first
    const cached = this.store.get(key);
    if (cached !== null) {
      console.log('[Cache] HIT for ' + key);
      return cached;
    }
    // Cache miss — load from DB
    console.log('[Cache] MISS for ' + key + ' — loading from DB');
    const value = this.db.get(key) || null;
    if (value !== null) {
      this.store.set(key, value);
      this.store.expire(key, 3600); // TTL 1 hour
    }
    return value;
  }

  set(key: string, value: string): void {
    // Write to DB first, then invalidate cache
    this.db.set(key, value);
    this.store.set(key, value);
    console.log('[Cache] Updated ' + key);
  }
}
```
